fields.hero_lede: Jeevan Rekha Hospital is a 220-bed super-speciality hospital in Raiganj, West Bengal, with NABL-accredited diagnostic services. The hospital strengthened its laboratory operations, with sample processing now 80% faster.
fields.overview_content:
Jeevan Rekha Hospital provides emergency care, inpatient and outpatient services, along with speciality treatments and diagnostic services. As diagnostic volumes increased, the laboratory team had to manage more samples, results and reports as part of its routine work.

Tracking samples, entering results, checking information and completing reports required additional time and effort. Processing delays, data-entry errors and repeated checking made these tasks more difficult and slowed down report completion. The team also had to spend more time resolving errors and following up on pending work.
fields.problem_heading: Four challenges affecting Jeevan Rekha's diagnostic lab

problems.title: Sample tracking gaps
problems.text: Tracking samples across different testing stages was difficult. The team spent additional time checking sample status and following up on pending samples.

problems.title: Result entry errors
problems.text: Manual result entry increased the risk of incorrect or missed information. Errors required additional checking and correction before reports could be completed.

problems.title: Report turnaround delays
problems.text: Higher diagnostic volumes made it harder to complete reports within the expected time. Delays in processing and verification increased report turnaround time.

problems.title: Limited team capacity
problems.text: The existing laboratory team had to handle increasing sample volumes without additional staff. This limited the team's ability to take on more diagnostic work.

fields.decision_heading: Why Jeevan Rekha Hospital chose Healthray LIMS
fields.decision_intro: Jeevan Rekha Hospital needed to improve sample tracking, reduce errors in result entry and speed up report completion as diagnostic volumes increased. It chose Healthray LIMS to bring these laboratory processes into a single digital workflow, with data migration support and a smooth transition for the laboratory team.
fields.quote_text: Earlier, tracking samples and completing reports took more time. With Healthray LIMS, our team can manage these tasks more easily and handle the increased sample volume more efficiently.
fields.solution_heading: How Healthray helped Jeevan Rekha streamline laboratory operations

solutions.title: Digital sample tracking
solutions.text: Healthray LIMS digitally recorded and tracked samples through different testing stages, reducing dependence on registers and verbal status updates.

solutions.title: Accurate result entry
solutions.text: Structured result entry and automated checks helped reduce manual entry errors and the correction work associated with them.

solutions.title: Faster report processing
solutions.text: Healthray LIMS moved test information through the reporting workflow more efficiently, reducing delays and helping the team complete reports faster.

solutions.title: Higher team productivity
solutions.text: The structured LIMS workflow helped the existing laboratory team handle higher sample volumes without additional staff, contributing to higher productivity.

fields.setup_heading: A smooth transition to Healthray LIMS
fields.setup_intro: Jeevan Rekha Hospital transitioned to Healthray LIMS without disrupting its ongoing diagnostic operations.

steps.title: Existing data migrated
steps.text: The hospital's laboratory data was migrated to Healthray LIMS.

steps.title: LIMS went live
steps.text: Healthray LIMS went live in under two weeks with no downtime.

steps.title: Laboratory staff onboarded
steps.text: Staff quickly adapted to the new LIMS workflow.

fields.results_intro: The shift from manual laboratory processes to a structured LIMS workflow delivered measurable improvements in processing speed, reporting, accuracy and productivity.

results.title: faster sample processing
results.text: Digital sample handling and tracking helped the laboratory process samples faster.

results.title: reduction in report turnaround time
results.text: A more structured result and reporting process reduced delays and helped reports reach doctors and patients sooner.

results.title: fewer manual entry and reporting errors
results.text: Standardised workflows and automated checks reduced avoidable errors, correction work and repeated entries.

results.title: higher productivity
results.text: The improved laboratory process helped the team manage more diagnostic work and increase overall productivity.
